$description: ProgressCircle (platform/components/ProgressCircle, library wave 4, lane B): its component tokens. The tones are ProgressBar's roles.

progress-circle-sm-size.$description: ProgressCircle size sm: the ring's box (16px).

progress-circle-md-size.$description: ProgressCircle size md: the ring's box (24px, the default).

progress-circle-lg-size.$description: ProgressCircle size lg: the ring's box (48px).

progress-circle-sm-stroke-width.$description: ProgressCircle size sm: the track's and the arc's width.

progress-circle-md-stroke-width.$description: ProgressCircle size md: the track's and the arc's width.

progress-circle-lg-stroke-width.$description: ProgressCircle size lg: the track's and the arc's width.

progress-circle-track-color.$description: ProgressCircle: the faint full ring under the arc (ProgressBar's track).

progress-circle-info-color.$description: ProgressCircle info: the arc (work under way; the default).

progress-circle-animation-duration.$description: ProgressCircle indeterminate: one turn of the arc (the spinner's loop).

progress-circle-value-color.$description: ProgressCircle lg: the percent in the center.

progress-circle-value-font-family.$description: ProgressCircle lg: the percent's face (the data font).

progress-circle-value-font-size.$description: ProgressCircle lg: the percent's size (11px, as ProgressBar's value).

progress-circle-value-line-height.$description: ProgressCircle lg: the percent's line height.
